clue.text: Shed first tear in court over writing

indicators.note: first asks for only the opening letter of the neighbouring word

parts.note: the opening letter of shed

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: CT is the standard abbreviation for court
to tear is to rip

explanation.surface: Someone sheds a tear in a courtroom on hearing a document read out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shed first' looks like a verb with an adverb, but it means the first letter of shed; the court abbreviation is split open to hold the tear.
explanation.definitionFit: A script is handwriting or a written text, so writing is a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Particular rampant mushroom in sci-fi production

indicators.note: in places the jumbled fungus inside the other jumbled word
rampant suggests running wild, so the fungus letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, without the hyphen

indicators.note: a production is something made or worked up, so the genre letters are rearranged

parts.note: a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcini

explanation.surface: A science-fiction film features a mushroom that grows out of control.
explanation.walkthrough: Two anagram signals work separately here: rampant on the fungus, production on the genre, and the jumbled fungus then sits just after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Specific and particular are adjective synonyms meaning relating to one precise thing rather than things generally.

clue.text: Backs raise before send-off

indicators.note: off here means out of order or awry, so the preceding word is scrambled

parts.note: to rear is to raise, as children or animals
the four letters of send, rearranged

explanation.surface: Players lift their backsides before a farewell party, or the referee sends someone off.
explanation.walkthrough: Send-off reads as one word, a farewell, but splits into the fodder and its anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Rear ends are backsides or bottoms, and backs is a playful plural noun for the same rear parts.

clue.text: Keep quiet over book

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
to book a table is to reserve it

explanation.surface: A librarian tells someone to keep quiet over their book.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, over means the first piece sits above, i.e. before, the second.
explanation.definitionFit: To preserve something is to keep it safe and unchanged, a plain verb synonym.

clue.text: Find record finished

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
something finished is over

explanation.surface: Someone finds that a recording session has ended.
explanation.definitionFit: To discover is to find something for the first time, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Bring in acne treatment of significance

indicators.note: a treatment works on something and changes it, so the skin complaint's letters are reworked

parts.note: to import goods is to bring them in
the letters of acne, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone stresses how significant it is to bring in a new treatment for spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Importance and significance are noun synonyms for the quality of mattering a great deal.

clue.text: Timid to admit, initially, not very easy to communicate

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the shy word takes other letters inside it

parts.note: coy means shy or timid

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the following words

parts.note: the first letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A shy person finds it hard to communicate and to admit things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not very easy to communicate' reads as one phrase, but 'easy' supplies its initial before the definition starts.
explanation.definitionFit: To convey an idea is to communicate or put it across, a plain verb synonym.

clue.text: Instrument uncovered evil gold ring

indicators.note: uncovered means stripped of the outer layer, so each word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: evil without its outer letters
gold without its outer letters
ring without its outer letters

explanation.surface: A detective uncovers a wicked gold-ring plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uncovered' acts on all three following words, not just the first.
explanation.definitionFit: A violin is a stringed musical instrument, so this is a definition by example.

clue.text: Give up job as lousy singer

indicators.note: lousy means bad or poorly done, so the letters are badly arranged and need sorting

parts.note: the six letters of this word, rearranged

explanation.surface: A poor vocalist decides to quit the profession.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to formally leave a post or position, which is giving up a job.

clue.text: In green, a melamine coating

indicators.note: In tells us the letters are sitting within the following words

parts.note: found across the end of green, the a and the start of melamine

explanation.surface: A green melamine finish on a kitchen worktop.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a hard glossy paint or glaze applied as a protective surface layer.

clue.text: Views the second of four gears

indicators.note: the second of asks for only the letter in position two of the next word

parts.note: the second letter of four
pinions are small toothed gear wheels

explanation.surface: Looks like a description of a car's gearbox, picking second out of four gears.
explanation.definitionFit: Opinions are personal views or beliefs, a plural noun synonym.

clue.text: One faces illness seldom

indicators.note: faces means stands in front of, so the first piece comes before the next

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a fever is an illness

explanation.surface: Someone rarely confronts sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used in 'rarely if ever', so it stands for hardly at all, meaning almost never.

clue.text: No-cost energy when very cold

parts.note: something costing nothing is free
zing is liveliness or energy

explanation.surface: Free energy would be welcome when the weather turns bitterly cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Freezing describes temperatures at or below the point where water turns to ice.

clue.text: Broken TV and a long time for benefits

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so these letters are put back together differently

parts.note: the letters of TV, and, a, rearranged
ages means a very long time

explanation.surface: A broken television means a long wait for social security payments.
explanation.definitionFit: Advantages are benefits or favourable circumstances, a plural noun synonym.

clue.text: Home dividend halved, double becomes single

indicators.note: halved means cut in two, so only one half of the word is kept

parts.note: in means at home
the first half of this eight-letter word
dual means double or twofold

explanation.surface: A financial puzzle: half a dividend at home, and a double turns into a single.
explanation.definitionFit: Individual means separate or one alone, an adjective synonym of the singular sense.

clue.text: Yet all thought must be curtailed

indicators.note: curtailed means having the tail cut off, so each word loses its final letter

parts.note: all without its last letter
thought without its last letter

explanation.surface: A complaint that all one's ideas still have to be cut short.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words lose their tails, not just the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Yet and although are both conjunctions introducing a contrast, as in 'small, yet strong'.

clue.text: Surprised to see pastry in transport

indicators.note: in places the first item inside the vehicle

parts.note: a sled is a sledge, a means of transport over snow
a tart is a pastry case with filling

explanation.surface: Someone is amazed to find a pastry on a bus or train.
explanation.definitionFit: Startled means suddenly alarmed or taken aback, an adjective close to surprised.

clue.text: Made for Mussolini on 1st of December

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
Il Duce, the leader, was Mussolini's title

indicators.note: 1st of asks for only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: the opening letter of December

explanation.surface: Something made for the Italian dictator to be ready on December the first.
explanation.definitionFit: Produced and made are past-tense verbs for creating or manufacturing something.

clue.text: Call our cat daft? At least it can multiply!

indicators.note: daft means silly or mixed up, so the preceding words are jumbled

parts.note: the ten letters of these three words, rearranged

explanation.surface: A pet owner admits the cat may be stupid but at least it can breed.
explanation.walkthrough: Multiply looks like the cat having kittens; in the definition it is arithmetic.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description: a pocket device for arithmetic can perform multiplication, unlike a dim pet.

clue.text: Just like shepherd to start gathering sheep as treasure?

indicators.note: gathering means collecting in, so those letters surround the animal
to start asks for the opening letters of the words before it

parts.note: the first letters of these three words
a ewe is a female sheep

explanation.surface: A shepherd rounding up the flock as if it were his precious hoard.
explanation.definitionFit: Jewels are precious stones, the typical contents of a treasure chest, so this is a loose example.

clue.text: Sounds like dabblers and charlatans

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the noises made by dabbling ducks
second meaning: frauds who pretend to medical skill

explanation.walkthrough: Sounds like looks like a homophone signal, but here it is literal: the sounds dabblers make. Dabblers are dabbling ducks, which feed at the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Ducks make this noise, and the same word is slang for fake doctors and other impostors.

clue.text: Kindly drop last rent

indicators.note: last asks for only the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: the final letter of drop
a lease is a rental agreement; to lease is to rent

explanation.surface: A request asking a landlord to waive the final rent payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are polite request words: 'kindly sit down' and 'please sit down' mean the same.

clue.text: Judge's ultimate trait is fairness

indicators.note: ultimate means last, so only the final letter of the word is kept

parts.note: the final letter of judge
a quality is a characteristic or trait

explanation.surface: The supreme characteristic of a good judge is being fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Equality means treating people the same, which is a form of justice or impartial treatment.

clue.text: Scrap over a joint

indicators.note: over means covering, so the first word wraps around the next

parts.note: a shred is a scrap or fragment
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fight breaks out over a cannabis cigarette.
explanation.walkthrough: Scrap looks like a fight and joint like a spliff; joint is the adjective, as in a joint account.
explanation.definitionFit: Shared and joint both describe something held or done in common by more than one person.

clue.text: Swap old coins

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
loose coins are called change

explanation.surface: A request to trade in some antique currency.
explanation.definitionFit: To exchange is to give one thing and receive another, a verb synonym for trade.

clue.text: Back up writer embracing student out in the open

indicators.note: back tells us to read the next short word in the opposite direction

parts.note: the word up read the other way

indicators.note: embracing means holding, so the pen wraps around the learner

parts.note: a Bic is a brand of ballpoint pen
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Someone supports an author who hugs a student openly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back up' reads as one phrase meaning support, but it splits into a reversal signal and its word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something public is done openly in view of everyone, the sense of out in the open.

clue.text: Uncertainty of distinguishing feature in meaning

indicators.note: in places the feature inside the word for meaning

parts.note: the sense of a word is its meaning
USP is a unique selling point, a marketing term

explanation.surface: A linguist is unsure what makes a word's meaning distinctive.
explanation.walkthrough: USP stands for unique selling point, the feature that sets a product apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspense is the anxious state of waiting without knowing the outcome.

clue.text: In the dark, quiet and possibly dead

indicators.note: possibly suggests a version that might be, so the letters can be rearranged

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
the letters of dead, rearranged

explanation.surface: A body lies silent in the darkness, possibly lifeless.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaded means sheltered from light, so a shaded spot is in shadow or darkness.
